decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 3 - The plant structures shall be removed when no longer required for use.

Condition : 4 - The acoustic barrier shown on the approved plans shall be erected prior to any part of the additional plant hereby approved commences operation and shall be removed when no longer required for noise mitigation.

Condition : 5 - Detailed drawings of the acoustic barrier, including details of materials and appearance, shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority before the erection of the barrier and the barrier shall not be erected otherwise than in accordance with any such approval.
description: Installation of additional plant and equipment at roof and basement level incorporating new accoustic screen at roof level to existing office building
